verdict.rationale: Tilled documents dispute management via both Dashboard and a DisputesAPI for custom flows, and webhooks provide real-time event notifications that could relay outcomes — consistent with a per-merchant marketplace model where each merchant has its own account. However, there's no explicit documentation confirming chargebacks are automatically routed/attributed to the correct sub-merchant or that dispute outcomes automatically reconcile against seller-specific balances/payouts. Missing for 10: explicit sub-merchant attribution logic for chargebacks, documentation of automatic balance/payout adjustment post-dispute-resolution, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
